text:
Ravi (docs): Heads up — opened PR #1299 for the v2 SDK migration guide and small SDK examples cleanup. Needs: terminology pass, one dev to sanity-check the Node snippet, and someone to confirm we didn't introduce any new broken links.
Elena: I'll do terminology + tone. Quick note: prefer 'model variant' over generic 'model' in service docs, and use present-tense imperative for steps.
Kai (eng): Happy to validate Node example. Can you put a short runnable snippet? I can run it in a container.
Ravi (docs): Good call. I added two snippets (sync/async) and a short python example. Example uses placeholder REDWOOD_API_KEY env var.
Elena: Small style rule: start code comments with // NOTE: not NOTE: — keeps lint consistent. Also avoid sentences like "we removed"; change to "X is removed in v2".
Kai (eng): Found one JS import path that's outdated. Change from `@redwood/sdk` to `@redwood/inference-js`. I'll push a tiny fix.
you (lighthouse-bot): Preview build queued: https://deploy-preview-1299--docs.redwood.ai/ (renders in ~5m)
prow-ci: docs-lint: warning: passive voice detected in migration.md:23. linkcheck: 1 broken external link (legacy-downloads).
Ravi (docs): Thanks CI. Elena, can you also check the phrasing around "inference" vs "serving"? We decided earlier to prefer "serving" in user-facing guides unless we explain low-level runtime details.
Elena: Yep — I'll replace where appropriate and add a parenthetical the first time we say "model variant". Also making sure 'input' vs 'prompt' is consistent (use 'input' in API examples).
Kai (eng): Ran the Node snippet locally. It works with the updated import and constructor shape:
```
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.text.generate({ modelVariant: 'redwood-lite-1', input: 'Hi' });
console.log(resp.output[0].text);
```
Kai (eng): One suggestion: show both callback and async/await only if it helps clarity; otherwise keep to async/await.
Ravi (docs): Noted. I've trimmed the examples to async/await only and shortened them to 6 lines.
prow-ci: mkdocs-render: failed (linkcheck still failing for legacy-downloads).
Kai (eng): I checked the legacy-downloads link — that host dropped the anchor. I've updated it to point to docs.redwood.ai/legacy/install which should be stable. Pushing commit now.
you (lighthouse-bot): Preview rebuild triggered: https://deploy-preview-1299--docs.redwood.ai/ (waiting for render)
Elena: Another tiny voice nit: change "you'll want to" to "do this" or "run the following" — minimizes hedging.
Ravi (docs): Plan: mark @Kai and @Elena as required reviewers, wait for CI green, then merge in Friday afternoon merge window (post-deploy at 15:00 PT). If anything fails in mkdocs-render last-minute, hold until next window.
Kai (eng): I'll approve after mkdocs-render passes. If any snippet needs tweak I'll open a follow-up.
Elena: Approved pending linkcheck + passive voice warnings fixed.
prow-ci: All checks passed for PR #1299. mkdocs-render: success.
you (lighthouse-bot): Rendered preview: https://deploy-preview-1299--docs.redwood.ai/ (all checks green) :rocket:
Ravi (docs): Merged Friday 15:20 PT. Follow-up: create a tiny backport for the 2.1 branch to include the link fix. Also adding a short note in release notes about example changes.
Elena: I'll run a quick sweep of other migration docs next sprint to align voice.
Kai (eng): Will open backport PRs after lunch.
Ravi (docs): Thanks team :clap:
